content: Foloy We Yael Jesus Wol Tayit We
Jesus yela wiri buwa we, iwe ngo sa bidah wol sew tayit sala marodiy mo iyang. Iwe ngo mokwe re dabeyal resa tteydoh irel,
ngo sa chaep yal foloyur:
Raey La Ye Halongol Katos

content.text: “Be momay lal deper rechokla re gola le ye tayikel yar tugul;
bo mala Lamliyel Laeng ila sa mel bo yar!
Be momay lal deper rechokla sa tayikof lal deper igla;
bo Deus bele hamomayu lal deper!
Be momay lal deper rechokla ye totol lal yar luluwal;
bo be yoh ngalir molwe Deus sa faesul hatugulu!
Be momay lal deper rechokla ye cchehas lal deper bo rebe foru mekla ye fel mo irel Deus;
bo re bele mel le ye kel lal deper bo re gola le Deus ye mel irer!
Be momay lal deper rechoka ye ffaho deper ngalir yarmat;
bo Deus yebe wol ffaho depal ngalir!
Be momay lal deper rechoka ye taldag lal buler;
Be momay lal deper rechoka re yengangel hopos;
bo Deus be ffesangur bo lol!
Be momay lal deper rechokla yarmat re kekafohoyur bo fal mala re foforu mekla ye fel mo irel Deus;
bo mala Lamliyel Laeng ila sa mel bo yar!

content: “Be momay lal dipmi irel yodla yarmat rebe hapatpat tayikof ngalugmi, ngo re hafohoyugmi, ngo re ffaor kaptami le ye tayikof bo fal mala hami choluway.
Ha hamomayu lal dipmi bo mala paliyel hafohoy kala yami ila ye mel wol laeng le fal ngalugmi. Iye sengal wululul hafohoy le re faor ngalir profeta kowe muswe.
Hasiga Mo Teram
“Hasa wochog hasiga ngalir pangal yarmat. Hare ye chuyloh mala tadel ngo towol yoh le sibe foru be taed. Towol yor pelal, si bele ppedaloh ngo yarmat re bele suru fedaley.
“Hasa wochog teram ngalir yarmetal faileng. Sew haplom le re hasudah mo woal sew tayit ila towe yoh le be mol.
Tor semal le be hagsu sew habul sa yetolong fael sew tapiy, bo yebe far yetedah wol mala faesul liliyel habul, bo yebe wer ngalir panger rechokla re mel yilim.
Be wol ila sengal teram la yami. Ye tugul le be wol werloh imor panger yarmat bo rebe wiri mekla ye momay le ha foforu, ngo re bele hapingpinga mala Tammi le ye mel woal laeng.
Folol Kofal Hatobtob We
“Ha towe luluwaley le isa budoh bo ibe homolaho Hatobtob we yael Moses mo foloy kowe yar profeta kowe. Ite budoh bo ibe hachuyaloh, bo ibudoh bo ibe foru yebe llahloh le foloy kala yar ila ye katos.
Habe memangi chog le yodle ye chil mel laeng mo talop, ngo tor sugfed mo irel Hatobtob we le be chuy yee, la hola miril faileng.

Iwe ngo yeramtala be hatawsi sugfed mo irel Hatobtob we, ngo ye foloyur yarmat rebe foru mala iy ye foloyu, ngo ye bela mel le be hartal totol mo irel mala Lamliyel Laeng. Ngo ligdi bo yeramtala be talenga Hatobtob la yael Deus ngo yesa foloyur yarmat bo rebe foru mala isa foru, ngo yebe tagiyet mo irel mala Lamliyel Laeng.
Iy be kangalugmi le be yoh le habe loh irel mala Lamliyel Laeng igle ye momay wegdegmi mo imor mokwe sensel Hatobtob we mo Pharisees kowe irel yami ma foru mekla ye fel mo irel Deus.
Folol Kofal Ssong
“Hasa moal rongrong molwe re kangalur yarmat muswe bo, ‘Ha towe hachuyaloh yael semal nngas; semal le be foru mele ngo rebe hasiloh irel liliyel tatelal hapatpat.’

Ngo ibe kangalugmi igla le: semal le be ssong ngal bisil ngo rebe hasiloh irel liliyel tatelal hapatpat. Semal le be kangalu mala bisil bo, ‘Gel ila tayichalmwo pelam!’ ngo rebe hasilong lal ttey. Iwe ngo semal le be kangalu bisil bo, ‘Ho buch ngo tayichalmwo pelam,’ ngo yebe loh Infiyerno.
Hare hosa loh ho bela fang yam maligach ngal Deus wol altar la yal, ngo sa mmang ngalug le yor yal molwe bisim ssong ngalug,
ngo hosa ligdi maligach we yam metal altar we, ngo hosa loh irel yodla chog bo ho bela hoposo llepdami mo mala bisim, iwe ngo hosa moch tefael bo hobe fang maligach we yam ngal Deus.

“Hare semal sa yichingewah le be hasug loh irel liliyel tatelal hapatpat, ngo hosa hafle llepdami irel yodla be chil yoh mo imol mala habe loh irel liliyel tatelal hapatpat. Bo ha bela hola chog lobola ngo bele hasug loh irel chol tetal we. Iwe ngo chol tetal we bele fangloh gel irel police, ngo police re bele yutlug long lal kalbus.
Ibe kangalugmi le ila lobola ha bela paoy iyang. Habe paoy iyang yee, lessiyal yal be yoh yami bakking ngo re moch hachuyah mo kalbus.
Folol Kofal Perafel Habulupoy
“Hasa mol rongrong we re sor bo, ‘Ho towe pera yael semal habulupoy.’
Iwe ngo iy be kangalugmi igla le semal le be kalngal semal fefel, ngo sa luluwal tayikof ngali, ila yesa for maltemay mo lal yal luluwal ngal fefel la.
Hare rel metam rela gilemera mele sa hasngalug molfid, ngo hosa haltu bo hobe ppedaloh. Bo ye momay tot le be chuy sugfed mo uwom mo imol mala rebe ppedug long lal Infiyerno.
Hare sere mala poam mele sa hasngalug molfid, ngo hosa supiy hobe ppedalo. Ye momay tot le be torloh sere poam mo imol mala rebe ppedug long lal Infiyerno.
Folol Kofal Habulupoy Ka Rema Mehal
“Hasa rongrong we re sor bo, ‘Semal le yebe mehal mo fefel la ril ngo be tefa sedep babiorol mahelal habulupoy sa fang ngal fefel we.’

Iwe ngo ibe kangalugmi igla le: hare semal mal ye hachuya fefel la ril le te fal mala fefel we yete katos ngali, ila ngo mal we mele ye tayikof irel yal la fangloh fefel we bo bela molfid, ngo semal le bela rili fefel we, ngo sa molfid bo sa hasi yael semal habulupoy.
Folol Meka Sima Hatugulu Fael Metal Deus
“Hasa wol rongrong le re kangalur yarmat muswe bo, ‘Ha towe hatawsi mekla hasa hatugulu, habe foru mekla hasa hatugulu ngal Deus bo habe foru.
Iwe ngo ibe kangalugmi igla le: ha towe hatugulu mo fael metal Deus mekla habe foru. Ha towe hatugulu mo fael idel laeng mekla habe foru bo laeng mele liliyel Deus;
hare ha teptap idel talop bo ila mala liliyel pechel, hare Jerusalem bo ila mala haplomol King
la ye hartal tagiyet.
Ha towe hatugulu mekla habe foru le habe tapeli mekla chimmi bo yami tugul bo towe yoh le habe foru seyal mekla yall chimmi bo be mosus hare towe mosus.
Mala chog habe sor ila, ‘Ngo’ hare ‘Yeb’ — te tugul mele ha bela moch kapta mo wol miril ngo ye budoh mo irel Moniyan.
Folol Hapaliyel Ngal Meka Ye Tayikof
“Hasa rongrong we resa moal sor bo, ‘Paliyel sefeas metal yarmat ila wol sefaes metal yarmat, ngo paliyel seyay ngi ila wol seyay ngi.’
Ngo ligdi bo ibe kangalugmi igla le: ha towe palili tayikof la semal sa faor ngalugmi. Hare semal ye ppigiri tepam rela gilemera, ngo hosa wigdi ngali rela gilchegil bo yebe wol ppigiri.
Hare semal sa hasugloh lal court bo be hastangug mala mengagol holongom, ngo hosa wol ngaley coat la mengagom.
Iwe ngo hare semal saldaw sa hakela ngalug bo hobe hasi lital irel sew mile, ngo hosa hasi irel ruwow mile.
Hare semal ye hafalpecheh bo hobe fang ngali sew formel ngo hosa ngaley. Ngo hare semal be dangroh sew formel le be teptap iyang, ngo sa moch hatefali ngo hosa ngaley.
Hachangir Rechokla Re Tayikof Ngalug
“Hasa rongrong mwo we re sor, ‘Habe hachangir wol maryarmi ngo hasa hafobidrir rechokla re tayikof ngalugmi.’
Iwe ngo igla ila ibe kangalugmi bo: ha hachangir rechokla re tayikof ngalugmi ngo hasa mapelar rechokla rema hafohoyugmi bo rebe yolbuw,
bo habe mel bo lol mala Tammi wol laeng. Ye foru yaal bo be werdiy uwor rechoka re tayikof mo rechoka re momay, ye fang yud ngalir rechoka rema foru meka ye momay mo ika rema foru meka ye tayikof.
Meda fal le Deus be fang paliyal ngalugmi le hare ha hachangir chog rechokla re hachangugmi? Bo chol hatteyel paliyel raeg mwo ngo wol ila senger.
Ngo hare maryarmi chog mele hama hapatpat ngalir, ila ngo meda mele hasa foru le ye wel tang ika yarmat rema faesul foforu? Rechoka mwo rete Kristiano ngo wol ila senger!
Habe mel chog le ha fel — le habe tappel chog mala Tammi woal laeng le ye fel.

footnotes.text: King: le ye sor mo iga ila Deus.
